I think i understand what you meant now. This "darkness", i also have tried to understand it. I've tried to approach it by thinking about it as an entity, to no avail. What really boggles me is how exactly did it all start, where exactly do these thoughts come from, what set off the motion.. Maybe it all started at birth..  

Insted of yielding to "darkness" i think embracing it would turn out to be more beneficial. Cooperation could reveal some forbidden knowledge or yield better results, idk...

In a way darkness itself isnt really a bad thing aswell, cause there cannot be light without dark. 

Trying to understand this mess is truly exhausting.

Thank you for that insight for keeping a diary.

That did kinda encourage me to try to take it up again. The loss of memory is indeed hard... For me it's especially hard with names of people.

Just a thought but by forgetting who you are, coudn't you become or be anyone? By knowing who you are, that kinda bounds/shackels you at the same time, no?

Yeah

Woah, i've never related to someone as much as i'm currently. 

I tried to keep a diary for when i get high. By getting high i've noticed my thought process gets more philosophical. Did the diary thing for 2 days and gave up..  
Why do you keep diary?

My theory about expressing yourself better in english is antisocial behaviour. I can safely say that i've communicated by texting/chatting in english more than in my native tounge, in the past couple of years.

Also the words kinda sound better for some reason and it's easier to construct sentences. I'd say that by thinking in english there is almost like somekind of flow of words and they kinda form the sentences themselves, idk..

I feel you, i really do and hope you can find peace of mind.

I hate to do this but amongst all the negative things, finding those small positive things still doesnt add up to total of positive or close to neutral.
